summary: Cinclus Pharma Holding AB (publ), a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, develops small molecules for the treatment of gastric acid-related diseases in China. The company's lead product is linaprazan glurate, a potassium-competitive acid blocker that has completed Phase II clinical trial to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease. It also develops linaprazan glurate with antibiotics, which is in pre-clinical trial for the treatment of peptic ulcer bacteria Helicobacter pylori. Cinclus Pharma Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
